CHAR-KALI.name: Adya Dakshina Kali (opening iconography)
CHAR-KALI.sentence: Adya Dakshina Kali (opening iconography) (attached CHAR-KALI): The dark shyama goddess who holds all colours. She has three eyes (sun, moon and fire) and a crescent on her forehead, and she wears a garland of fifty syllable beads; exactly as in the attached character sheet

CHAR-MARKANDEYA.name: Markandeya Rishi
CHAR-MARKANDEYA.sentence: Markandeya Rishi (attached CHAR-MARKANDEYA): A lean, elderly Himalayan sage with a tall white jata knot and a long white beard. He wears a stone-grey shawl and a maroon dhoti, holds a tulsi-bead mala, and has a calm teaching gaze; exactly as in the attached character sheet

CHAR-HIMALAYAN-MUNIS.name: The Himalayan munis
CHAR-HIMALAYAN-MUNIS.sentence: The Himalayan munis (attached CHAR-HIMALAYAN-MUNIS): A group of ascetics with 5 to 7 visible in front and the rest suggested by depth and shadow. They have matted hair, bark-ochre garments and kamandalus; exactly as in the attached character sheet

CHAR-BRAHMA.name: Brahma
CHAR-BRAHMA.sentence: Brahma (attached CHAR-BRAHMA): The four-faced creator, with three faces visible from the front and the fourth implied. His skin is lotus-filament gold and each face has a white beard; exactly as in the attached character sheet

CHAR-SANDHYA.name: Sandhya
CHAR-SANDHYA.sentence: Sandhya (attached CHAR-SANDHYA): A dignified young woman with four arms, as told here, and peacock-dark hair. Her eyes are wide like blue lotuses, startled like a doe's. She wears a fully draped twilight-violet sari with the uttariya over both shoulders; exactly as in the attached character sheet

CHAR-MANASA-PUTRAS.name: Marichi and the mind-born sons
CHAR-MANASA-PUTRAS.sentence: Marichi and the mind-born sons (attached CHAR-MANASA-PUTRAS): Five to seven visible sages, with the rest suggested by depth. Marichi stands in front with a dark beard and an ochre-white uttariya. They wear sacred threads and carry kamandalus; exactly as in the attached character sheet

CHAR-KAMADEVA.name: Kamadeva (Manmatha, Madana, Kandarpa)
CHAR-KAMADEVA.sentence: Kamadeva (Manmatha, Madana, Kandarpa) (attached CHAR-KAMADEVA): A handsome youth with a golden body and hands, face and feet tinged red. He has a broad chest, a slender waist and a conch-like neck; exactly as in the attached character sheet

CHAR-SHIVA.name: Shiva (Shambhu, Mahadeva, Hara)
CHAR-SHIVA.sentence: Shiva (Shambhu, Mahadeva, Hara) (attached CHAR-SHIVA): Crystal-ash skin with moon-silver highlights. He has a tall jatajut with a crescent moon, and serpents coil at his neck and upper arms. He wears a tiger-skin garment with stripes in ash and void tones; exactly as in the attached character sheet
